data: Apple reported net income of $112,010 million ($112.0 billion) for fiscal 2025, which ended September 27, 2025, while NVIDIA reported $72,880 million ($72.9 billion) for its fiscal 2025, which ended January 26, 2025. Apple's figure is about 1.54 times NVIDIA's ($112,010 / $72,880), or roughly $39.1 billion higher. The two fiscal years are not aligned: NVIDIA's ended about eight months before Apple's, so the comparison is between different calendar periods. NVIDIA's net income was also growing much faster, up from $29,760 million in its fiscal 2024, versus Apple's rise from $93,736 million.
